about: VRM motion library bake list (docs/vrm-motion-system.md §3.7, §5). Metadata only: no model or animation is in the repository. scripts/vrm-bake.js reads each `src` from $PIXELPET_VRM_ASSETS (default ~/vrm-assets) and writes <out>/<style>/<slot>.vrma plus library.json outside the repository. All source motions are for personal use only.

stand.relaxed@female.label: 放松站
stand.relaxed@female.note: Standing · Arms Down (the design's alternate: faces the user; 2278ba9c turns her 60° away, §5.1)

stand.confident@female.label: 叉腰站
stand.confident@female.note: Standing · Right Hand On Hip; neck and head turned 25° back towards the user (the source looks 33° aside: the posture cycle turned her head that far, T-2691)

stand.shy@female.label: 害羞低头
stand.shy@female.note: Standing · Looking Down To The Right

sit.rest@female.label: 跷腿坐
sit.rest@female.note: Sitting · Legs Crossed, Right Arm Over Knee: a seat sit; the renderer puts a pouf under her hips (T-2691: the floor sit with both hands on the head read as floating)

sit.doze@female.label: 后撑坐
sit.doze@female.note: Sitting · Arms Supporting: leans back on her hands on the seat (the renderer's pouf); replaces the reclined floor sit whose legs hung in the air (T-2691)

sit.doze@male.label: 低头坐
sit.doze@male.note: Sitting · Reaching Hands Towards Toes (a floor sit instead of the chair sit 14ee62b6, §5.1); knees bent 14° more so the stretched legs never bend backwards (T-2711: the source knees were at −9°)

idle.happy@female.label: 轻松待机
idle.happy@female.note: Relaxed contrapposto idle, 8.8 s: weight on one leg, head within ±10° (T-2691: Standing Happily swept the head ±25° and twisted the hips ±20° every few seconds); head turned 5° back to centre (the clip looks slightly to her right)

idle.variant2@female.label: 换脚待机
idle.variant2@female.note: Weight-shift idle, 16.6 s at 80%: a different file from idle.happy, slow shifts from leg to leg (T-2691); neck + head turned 8° back to centre (the clip drifts its gaze 15° to her right)

idle.posture-cycle@female.label: 换姿势待机
idle.posture-cycle@female.note: relaxed ↔ confident every 16 s (T-2691: with stand.playful, whose hips turn 47° away, and every 12 s it read as a regular big twist)

idle.happy@male.label: 看手待机
idle.happy@male.note: Standing idle, 18.5 s at 90%: shifts his weight, now and then lifts a hand to look at it (T-2691: the 2 s Happy Idle loop read as standing still)

idle.variant2@male.label: 抱臂待机
idle.variant2@male.note: Arms-folded idle, 5.5–25.25 s at 85% (the stretch whose ends meet: loop seam 16°): rocks his weight, turns his shoulders a little (T-2691)

idle.posture-cycle@male.label: 换姿势待机
idle.posture-cycle@male.note: relaxed → hand on hip → hand behind the head every 14 s (T-2691: every 18 s left him standing still most of the time; his idle clips carry the small gestures)

react.touch-head@female.label: 被摸头·低头蹭
react.touch-head@female.note: Looking Down To The Right, upper body at 55%: she lowers her head into the hand

react.touch-face@female.label: 戳脸·鼓脸扭头
react.touch-face@female.note: Hands On Hips Looking Over Shoulder, head and neck only, the turn boosted 1.35× at 95%: she turns her face well away with a pout (T-2711: at 65% the peak was 21°, too small to read); the source pose twists the torso ~90° away, too much for a poke (T-2681 review)

react.shy@female.label: 害羞低头
react.shy@female.note: P0 stand-in for cover_chest (VMD, P1): head down and turned away, eyes down to the side

react.annoyed@female.label: 往后躲
react.annoyed@female.note: Leaning Back, Left Hand On Hip at 45%: a lean away; at full weight the source twists her torso ~90° from the user (T-2681 review)

react.ticklish@female.label: 怕痒笑
react.ticklish@female.note: Super Excited 0–2.5 s at 60% (P0 stand-in for emote/happy1.vmd)

react.drop@female.label: 落地站稳
react.drop@female.note: stand.relaxed snapped in (0.15 s) with a knee dip from the alive layer

hold.lift@female.label: 被拎起·缩手悬空
hold.lift@female.note: Arms Down with the shoulders up and both hands drawn in to the chest like a picked-up kitten (the old On Knees, Arms Raised covered her face); hips upright at standing height, legs baked hanging straight down with the toes pointing down; the alive layer swings them with the window (T-2691)

hold.think@female.label: 思考
hold.think@female.note: Leaning Back, Left Hand On Hip, arms only (hand to the hip) + eyes up right; the torso twist of the source is left out (T-2681 review)

hold.eat@female.label: 吃东西
hold.eat@female.note: stand.relaxed upper body, chewing nods (alive layer) and the chewing mouth

hold.talk@female.label: 说话·摊掌讲解
hold.talk@female.note: Talking with both palms up and open in front of her, small nods (5.5 s of a talking clip, upper body at 90%); one of three talk segments the director rotates through (T-2711: the old mirrored hand gesture at 50% moved the upper arms only 18/9°)

hold.talk-2@female.label: 说话·交握点头
hold.talk-2@female.note: Hands clasped in front, leaning in and nodding along: the soft, listening-and-answering segment (6 s, upper body at 90%)

hold.talk-3@female.label: 说话·双手递出
hold.talk-3@female.note: Both hands offered forward as she presents a point (2.3 s before the source turns away, upper body at 90%)

hold.walk@female.label: 走路·轻盈窄步
hold.walk@female.note: A light walk on a narrow line (feet almost in one track) with a soft, wide arm swing; 1.37 s per two steps at 1.05 m/s in the source. Baked in place (the forward travel taken out, the hip sway kept); the director plays it at the window's pace so the feet do not slide (T-2711)

react.touch-head@male.label: 被摸头·挠头
react.touch-head@male.note: Right Hand Behind Head at 85%, head a little down: he rubs the back of his head, embarrassed (T-2691: Looking Right at 50% barely moved)

react.touch-face@male.label: 戳脸·偏头躲
react.touch-face@male.note: Looking Left, upper body, head / neck turn boosted 1.5×: he jerks his head and shoulders away from the finger, short and direct (T-2691: 55% read as no reaction; T-2711: 25° peak still small)

react.shy@male.label: 背手低头
react.shy@male.note: Arms Behind Back, head bowed and turned aside at 95%: he hides his hands and looks away (T-2691: was the same head scratch as react.touch-head)

react.angry@male.label: 生气指人
react.angry@male.note: Quickly Pointing Angrily Forward, 0–0.33 s at 130%: the jab out to the full point, held 1.4 s on that frame (T-2691: Angry Forward Gesture moved the head only; holding the 0.5 s frame held a pose past the point)

react.annoyed@male.label: 抱臂不耐烦
react.annoyed@male.note: Arms folded (5.0 s of the arms-folded idle) at 90%, eyes away: closes off instead of leaning away (T-2691)

react.ticklish@male.label: 怕痒·笑着护住
react.ticklish@male.note: Hands up to the face, 0.3–2.6 s: he doubles up laughing and fends it off (T-2691: the hand gesture at 80% was half of hers)

react.drop@male.label: 落地站稳
react.drop@male.note: stand.relaxed snapped in, a smaller knee dip

react.greet@male.label: 抬手打招呼
react.greet@male.note: One hand up, 3.5 s: a casual raised-hand hello (T-2691: the bow was a quarter of her wave)

react.cheer@male.label: 握拳欢呼
react.cheer@male.note: Both fists up, 3.2 s: a short, direct cheer (T-2691: the hand gesture was a third of hers)

hold.lift@male.label: 被拎起·垂手无奈
hold.lift@male.note: Looking Forward with the shoulders drawn up, the arms hanging a little forward with soft elbows and the head down at his dangling feet (a resigned 被拎起来了…); legs baked hanging like hold.lift@female. Replaces Arms Spread Looking Upwards, whose arms stood out stiffly in an A (T-2691)

hold.think@male.label: 思考·托下巴
hold.think@male.note: Hand to the chin (1.6 s of a thinking clip) at 85% + eyes up right (T-2691: Looking Right only turned the head)

hold.eat@male.label: 吃东西
hold.eat@male.note: stand.relaxed upper body, chewing nods and mouth

hold.talk@male.label: 说话·张臂讲解
hold.talk@male.note: Explaining with both arms opened wide and the palms out, at 80% of the source size (6 s, upper body); one of three male talk segments (T-2711)

hold.talk-2@male.label: 说话·单手比划
hold.talk-2@male.note: One hand chopping and pointing as he makes his points, the other at his side: direct, energetic (6 s, upper body)

hold.talk-3@male.label: 说话·抬手解释
hold.talk-3@male.note: One forearm across, the other hand raised to explain, then back down (4.4 s, upper body)

hold.walk@male.label: 走路·大步摆臂
hold.walk@male.note: A relaxed, longer stride with the feet a hip-width apart and a loose arm swing; 1.4 s per two steps at 1.12 m/s in the source. Baked in place like hold.walk@female (T-2711)
